# kay

> kay is a Bun web framework. A `.kay` file is one component: TypeScript fences, then a pug-like indented template. Pages render to plain HTML strings on the server, islands run on kay's own signals and DOM runtime, and an Elysia plugin serves it all with automatic islands. Everything is typed, templates included, and `kay check` reports errors at the `.kay` line and column.

## Rules that are easy to get wrong

- Every dynamic value sits in `{}`: `a(href={url})`, `p Hello {name}`. A static attribute value is a quoted string: `a(href="/about")`.
- A signal or memo is read by calling it, `count()`, in the template as in the script; one the template names bare where its value goes is an error, `uncalled-signal`, which `kay check --fix` calls. It is written by assigning it, in both: `count = 0`, `count += step`, `count++` and `open = !open()` compile to `.set`, and `count.set(c => c * 2)` still works; assigning works on any signal a `const`, an import or a prop typed `Signal<T>` from `kay` holds, wherever it was made, and one in a `let` or a property takes `.set`. Handed on whole, `Toggle(open={open})`, `bind:value={query}` or a function's argument, it passes the signal itself, for a prop typed `Signal<T>`. Props and server data are plain names: `{title}`, not `{title()}`.
- A `for` matches its rows across renders by `item.id`, else by the item itself; rows of plain objects edited immutably keep their nodes with no key, and `key={post.slug}` names another key.
- An `await` block streams any promise it is given, `await comments`, `await data.comments`, a prop or one a component makes; a rejection before it renders crashes nothing, and `defer()` is no longer needed.
- The component script exports types only. Shared values live in `.ts` modules.
- A page has no props: its data comes from its `--- server` fence.
- `window`, `document`, `localStorage` and the other globals only a browser has are read in `effect` or `onMount`, or in a component whose script fence is `--- client`; reading one while rendering throws on the server.
- Durations kay's config and server code take are seconds as a number, or a number with its unit as a string, `'250ms'`, `'30s'`, `'5m'`, `'1.5h'`, `'30d'` or `'2w'` (type `Duration` from `kay`): `cached`'s `ttl`, `revalidate`, a session's `maxAge`, `rateLimit`'s `window`, an action's `minTime` and `shutdownTimeout`. `every`, `debounced`, `rooms.coalesce`, `sqliteRooms` and the delays of kayjs-cms and kayjs-ui take the string alone (type `DurationText`), and a bare number throws. Each must be positive, which `kay check` reports for a literal `cached` ttl and the server for the rest. In milliseconds, as `bun:test`'s own timeouts are, `kay/test`'s browser `timeout`; a store's `set(id, data, maxAge)` gets seconds.
- Indentation is spaces only, consistent within a block. Text after a tag needs one space: `p Hello`, never `p:Hello`.
- Under `kay dev`, `.kay/dev/errors.json` lists the errors the server met, a compile error at its `.kay` line, a request that threw with its stack on `.kay` lines, or an island's error in the browser: read it rather than opening the browser.
- Pug features that do not exist: `- code` lines, `#{}` and `!{}` interpolation, `+mixins`, `include`, `extends`, `block`, filters, `&attributes`, `case`, `each`, `while`, `unless`, `doctype`; a line starting with one is reported, with what kay writes instead.

## Docs

To build a site, read [Build a site](llms/site.md) first: one page walking through config, layout, content pages, islands and a form. The topic files below cover what it leaves out: open one when a task needs more. Each opens with its common tasks, one sentence and one example apiece, which answer most tasks; the exact rules follow under Reference, one per bullet, to search for an edge case.

- [Build a site](llms/site.md): a small site: config, layout and nav, a Markdown collection, the 404 page, islands, a form checked on both sides
- [Components](llms/components.md): the fences of a `.kay` file, props, signals, memos, effects, generic components, `import.meta.glob`
- [Component libraries and extensions](llms/component-libraries.md): shipping components in a package, and the pages, dev tool tabs and commands a library adds
- [Template lines](llms/templates.md): elements, classes, attributes, events, bindings, `if`/`for`/`await`/`try` blocks, slots, snippets
- [Head and site metadata](llms/head.md): `head` in templates, site-wide SEO defaults and social cards
- [Sitemap, favicon, offline, search and fonts](llms/sitemap-search-fonts.md): sitemap, robots.txt, favicon, web manifest, offline, search, fonts
- [Styles and assets](llms/styles-and-assets.md): component styles and Tailwind, `public/`, imported files, wasm and workers
- [Images and icons](llms/images.md): imported and responsive images, share cards, resizing stored or remote images, Iconify icons
- [Islands](llms/islands.md): props, hydration, shared and persisted state, transitions, error fallbacks, context
- [Browser-only code](llms/browser-only.md): browser-only components, browser globals on the server, server globals in the browser
- [Navigation and pages kay does not serve](llms/navigation.md): in-place navigation, islands kept across pages, forms posting in place
- [Pages and routing](llms/routing.md): file-based routes, params, layouts, the server fence and `ctx`
- [Endpoint files, redirects, rewrites, base path](llms/routing-endpoints-and-base.md): `llms.txt.ts` exporting `GET`, `redirects`, `rewrite`, `base`
- [Prerendering and static export](llms/prerendering.md): prerendered pages, revalidation, server islands, static export
- [Content collections](llms/content.md): Markdown, JSON and YAML collections read against a schema, entries as pages, feeds
- [Loaded collections and preview mode](llms/content-cms.md): loaders for a CMS or a database, preview mode for drafts, a CMS
- [Edit mode and the CMS editor](llms/content-edit.md): edit mode's markers on a page, the editor island, `showDraft`
- [Locales](llms/locales.md): i18n: locale prefixes, typed messages, number and date formatting, redirecting a visitor to their locale
- [Caching and streaming](llms/rendering.md): caching rendered pages and data, streaming with `await` blocks, `renderToString` for mails and feeds
- [Actions](llms/actions.md): form posts that work without JavaScript, typed by a schema: validation errors, files, redirects
- [Calling actions from islands](llms/actions-from-islands.md): `pending()`, `track()`, streaming answers, optimistic changes, actions as props
- [Schemas](llms/schemas.md): one schema for the server, its type read by islands
- [Protecting actions and limiting requests](llms/action-protection.md): cross-site posts, guards on actions, rate limits, body limit
- [Stored files](llms/files.md): uploads on disk or in S3, links from pages, resizing, private links, upload progress
- [Locals, sessions and guards](llms/server.md): `ctx.locals`, cookie sessions and stores, `_guard.ts` route guards
- [Environment variables](llms/environment.md): a typed `defineEnv`, variables read by islands
- [API routes](llms/api-routes.md): Elysia modules under `src/api/`, CORS, OpenAPI, and the MCP endpoint
- [Calling API routes from islands](llms/api-from-islands.md): typed route reads, server-sent events, streaming actions
- [Live values, cached values and presence](llms/live-values.md): `live()`, presence, websockets
- [Rooms](llms/rooms.md): groups of websocket connections, shared state, a snapshot on join
- [Testing](llms/testing.md): `kay/test`, pages and actions in `bun test`
- [Test databases and setup](llms/testing-setup.md): `kay/test/preload`, a database per file, seeds
- [Testing in a browser](llms/testing-browser.md): `site.open`, headless Chrome
- [Checks and lints](llms/checks.md): what `kay check` verifies, ESLint on `.kay` files
- [Lints and warnings](llms/lints.md): every lint at its default level, how to change a level, allow one, or apply its fix
- [Errors](llms/errors.md): the codes of the errors that are no lint, and where each fix is documented
- [Project setup and scaffolding](llms/project.md): `kay.config.ts`, tsconfig, editor setup, migrating from Astro
- [kay new and kay add](llms/project-new-and-add.md): presets, features, adding one to a project
- [The dev server](llms/dev-server.md): `kay dev` and its error page
- [The dev tool](llms/dev-tool.md): its tabs and the problems it lists
- [Building and starting](llms/build-and-start.md): `kay build`, one executable, a static export, `kay start`
- [Check, inspect and tool commands](llms/check-and-tools.md): `kay check`, `render`, `routes`, `env`, `doctor`, `upgrade`, `explain`, `fmt`, `kay/compiler`
- [Language server, screenshot and MCP](llms/editor-and-agent-commands.md): `kay lsp`, `kay screenshot`, `kay mcp`
- [Running in production](llms/production.md): request logs, tracing, health checks, graceful shutdown, cron and background jobs
- [Queues](llms/queues.md): jobs surviving a restart
- [Proxies, security headers and compression](llms/proxy-and-security.md): a proxy, security headers and CSP, compression
- [Upgrading](llms/upgrading.md): what each recent minor breaks, and what an app changes
- [Upgrading, older releases](llms/upgrading-archive.md): the same for the minors before 1.57
- [What's new](llms/whats-new.md): what each recent release adds, newest first
- [What's new, older releases](llms/whats-new-archive.md): the same for the releases before 1.63
- [Privacy and personal data](llms/privacy.md): what kay keeps and for how long, erasing a person
- [Analytics and Web Vitals](llms/analytics.md): visits and real load times through your origin, consent
- [Eco-design](llms/eco-design.md): the RGESN criteria kay meets, checks or leaves to the app
